pages.text: Certain items influencing the contract when it is created will denote $(bold)actions$() that the bound mob must perform.$(br2)For instance, a hopper will tell it to collect all the dropped items it sees.

Anything influencing an action will act as a $(bold)filter$(). For instance, this diagram tells a mob to pick up only gold nuggets or iron nuggets.$(br2)The specifics of how filters work depends on the action, and will be covered in other sections.
